goal: Users see deterministic neutral fallbacks for invalid, missing, negative, non-finite, and extreme dates and durations while valid values remain locale-aware.
non_goals: Do not restyle route families or the application shell.
Do not change backend, API, permission, persistence, or pipeline state contracts.
Do not edit page-local direct Date formatters in this slice.
Do not add dependencies or copy prototype implementation code.
expected_evidence: Focused Vitest output covering valid and invalid date and duration inputs.
Frontend Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, and Vite build output.
Independent spec and quality review artifacts.
unsafe_assumptions: Finite timestamps may still be outside the JavaScript Date range.
Zero, missing, and invalid duration values may have distinct domain meanings.
Existing page-local Date formatting is not automatically covered by shared composition tests.
stop_condition: Stop before editing outside the four allowed files or if fallback semantics require a new product, API, permission, persistence, or component-boundary decision.
